mechanics.title: Pack stack sizes
mechanics.description: The pack's global config (the legacy allstackable-global-config.json, which StackItUp migrates automatically) applies to every new world. Stack of 64: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, crimson and warped signs; boats (oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak); minecarts (plain, chest, furnace, hopper, TNT, command block); armor stands; all beds and banners; empty buckets; cake; eggs; snowballs; enchanted books; ender pearls; honey bottles; saddles; writable and written books; and most music discs. Stack of 16: filled buckets (water, lava, milk, powder snow, fish, axolotl), potions (normal, splash, lingering), mushroom/beetroot/rabbit/suspicious stews, all shulker boxes, shields and totems of undying.

mechanics.title: World rules
mechanics.description: The config sets applyGlobalConfigToAllNewGames=1, permissionLevel=4 (commands require operator) and stackEmptyShulkerBoxOnly=0 (filled shulker boxes stack too).

vanilla_changes.change: Many items that stack to 1 or 16 in vanilla now stack to 16 or 64 as listed in mechanics.

qol: Fewer inventory slots used by boats, beds, banners, potions, ender pearls, enchanted books, discs and similar items.
commands_and_keybinds: /stackitup set [item] [count] | set hand [player] | set vanilla [default] [new] | set modified [current] [new] | set all [current] [new]
/stackitup config reload | loadFromGlobal | saveToGlobal | globalConfigAutoApply [true/false] | restore
getting_started: Run /stackitup show all to see which items are modified in your world.
editor_notes: Author README is mostly empty; details come from source and the pack config (35 items at 16, 77 at 64). Signs listed are only the 8 types above (no bamboo, cherry, mangrove, pale oak or hanging signs). Global config applies to NEW worlds; existing worlds keep their own stackitup-config.json.
name: StackItUp
summary: Lets item stack sizes be changed per item. The pack ships a global configuration that raises many normally unstackable or low-stack items to 16 or 64. It is the pack author's rebuild of AllStackable.
